facts.text: I have been experimenting with different baking recipes.
I was wondering what types of pastries I could make that feature caramel as a main ingredient.
I am especially interested in trying out caramel éclairs.
I recently made a caramel apple tart for my family's Sunday dinner.
My family's Sunday dinner caramel apple tart was a huge hit.
I got my new stand mixer as a birthday gift from my sister last month.
I have been using a recipe that involves melting sugar and butter together to make caramel.
I slowly add heavy cream to melted sugar and butter to create a smooth caramel sauce.
The caramel sauce recipe has worked out really well so far.
I usually use the whisk attachment when making caramel.
I find the whisk attachment helps incorporate the cream more evenly.
I haven't tried using different types of sugar yet.
I plan to experiment with different types of sugar soon.
I use caramel sauce mostly as a topping for baked goods.
I have been using caramel sauce as a topping for the apple tart I mentioned earlier.
I have been thinking about using caramel sauce to make caramel macchiatos.
I am more of a DIY coffee enthusiast.
I have been experimenting with different coffee recipes at home.
I recently got a new coffee grinder.
I recently got a milk frother.
I have been trying out different coffee drinks and flavor combinations.
I am thinking about starting a small coffee and baking blog.
I want to share my recipes and experiments on my blog.
I have been considering calling my blog "The Daily Grind".
I will check out coffee and baking blogs and take tips into consideration as I start my own blog.
